name: Unknown OEM (dummy) PX-1 with a proprietary CAN
class: Car whose CAN database is not public: the decoder file is a DUMMY
interfaces: CAN 500 kbit/s, 11-bit identifiers: a proprietary network, described here by a DUMMY decoder file
notes: Proprietary CAN needs its manufacturer's decoder file, which this project does not have. proprietary_dummy.dbc is a placeholder with invented identifiers and layouts; delete the decoder file from Vantage's decoders folder to see the link stay 'unidentified'.
